name: Tenshi no Milk Tank ~Futanari LL Set~
original_name: 天使のミルクタンク～ふたなりＬＬセット～
source:
Milk Angel Milmo was worried that she wasn't selling as much milk as other angels while her graduation test drew nearer at Milky Angel Girls Academy.
Her friend Daisy came to visit her at her milky shop to impart some girl-to-girl advice...
With her help, will Milmo be able to graduate, or will it all go tits up!?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE086399.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
毕业考试日益临近，牛奶天使米尔莫却忧心忡忡，因为她卖出的牛奶始终不如其他天使多。
朋友黛西来到她经营的牛奶店，以女孩的身份传授了一些贴心建议……
有了黛西的帮助，米尔莫能顺利毕业吗？还是一切终究会彻底砸锅！？

[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE086399.html]DLsite English[/url]]
